headline: Forest Ranger Aide
summary: Forest ranger aide with three years protecting a watershed forest reserve in Iloilo. I patrol the reserve, lead tree-planting and nursery work, and help communities manage their forest areas sustainably. I also respond to forest fires and landslides and encode our patrol reports.
skills: Emergency response to fires and landslides

experience.title: Forest Ranger Aide
bullets: Patrol 2,000 hectares of watershed forest with a team of four and report illegal cutting.
Run the seedling nursery and lead planting of native trees with volunteers.
Help upland communities plan sustainable harvesting of their woodlots.
Respond to forest fires and landslides with local rescue teams.
Encode patrol logs and planting records every week.

experience.title: Nursery Worker
bullets: Grew native tree seedlings and prepared them for planting.
